public_rationale: October 28 is before the end of the named year. The SpaceX report documents a drawdown after index entry, but one share-price decline does not establish that retail investors and index funds broadly inherited substantial AI-investment losses. limitations: The sole cited investment example is contextual, not a measure of the full claimed investor outcome.

The 2026 exposure period and the later loss-assessment period may differ.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: 2026 will be remembered as the year retail investors and index funds were left holding the bag on AI investments, though the timing of the collapse is unknown.

statement.excerpt: Prediction: Nobody knows when this will all collapse, but 2026 will be remembered in hindsight as the year in which retail investors and index funds were left holding the bag.
statement.document_title: Why things will eventually fall apart

from_speaker: Nobody knows when this will all collapse
our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that 2026 places substantial AI-related investment exposure with retail investors and index funds, leaving them to bear material losses from a subsequent correction.
Holding the bag requires evidence of burdensome investment losses, not merely buying shares or experiencing ordinary volatility.
2026 dates the exposure or loss-bearing episode. Marcus expressly leaves the ultimate collapse date unknown, so losses need not all be realized by December 31.
The horizon ends December 31, 2026 for the named year; further hindsight may still be needed after that date.
Unknown collapse timing is a timing qualification, not a separate conditional antecedent.
The assessment tests the underlying investment outcome, not whether future commentators literally remember the year this way.
criteria.support_condition: Ownership and investment-flow records establish substantial 2026 exposure for both retail investors and index funds, with material subsequent losses attributable to that exposure and evidence supporting the claimed transfer of downside to those holders.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Complete records for the 2026 episode and its subsequent resolution show no substantial transfer of such exposure to both groups, or establish that the relevant holdings did not leave them bearing material losses. A short-term rally is insufficient.
